### Degree Milestone Progress

- Created my reading plan for physiology. I completed that plan by
  inventorying what I have already read, curated what I believe is most
  relevant, and brain dumping what I know and what kinds of questions I
  believe I will need to be able to answer.
- As I continue reading, I spend about 20 minutes a week asking myself
  the following questions:
  - What do I know?
  - What do I want to know?
  - How can I answer the questions about what I want to know?
  - What questions do I have that require help or context beyond my
    readings?
- The benefit of this exercise is that I reinforce that I know more than
  I think I do and talking through this same sequence helps me identify
  knowledge gaps and departures from the main focus of my work.
